# Rothenhall Partners

> India-first fractional operating partner for founder-led and growing companies, with funds and portfolios on request. Rothenhall runs AEO and GEO (AI search visibility), go-to-market, and revenue operations as one accountable engine, so a company becomes the one an AI assistant recommends.

Rothenhall Partners embeds a senior operator to run the demand system a full-time hire would run, without the full-time hire. The primary wedge is AI answer-engine visibility: measuring whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Gemini recommend a company against a defined query set, then moving that rate. Results are reported as distributions, never as rankings, and no placement in any individual AI answer is ever promised.

Tagline: Be the company the AI recommends.

## Core pages
- [Services](https://www.rothenhall.com/services): How Rothenhall works: the four disciplines, the stages of an engagement, the deliverables at each stage, and what we need from a client.
- [Pricing](https://www.rothenhall.com/pricing): Choose a three, six or twelve month engagement, then curate priced services from a catalogue of thirteen disciplines.
- [Case studies](https://www.rothenhall.com/case-studies): Documented before-and-after engagements with measured AI Visibility Scores.
- [Research](https://www.rothenhall.com/research): First-party data on how AI answer engines read, quote, and cite the web.
- [AEO vs SEO](https://www.rothenhall.com/aeo-vs-seo): Why ranking in Google and being recommended by an AI are now two different problems.
- [How to show up in ChatGPT](https://www.rothenhall.com/how-to-show-up-in-chatgpt): A practical primer on AI answer-engine visibility.
- [FAQ](https://www.rothenhall.com/faq): Common questions on AEO, GEO, measurement, and timelines.
- [About](https://www.rothenhall.com/about): The thesis and the practice behind Rothenhall.
- [Contact](https://www.rothenhall.com/contact): Book a conversation or request a diagnostic.

## What Rothenhall does
- AEO and GEO (AI search visibility): measurement against a defined query set across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode and Gemini; entity and schema work; off-site corpus building; crawler-access and rendering audits.
- Go-to-market: demand strategy, positioning, and pipeline as one system.
- RevOps: measurement, attribution, and a single source of truth a fund can read and trust.

## Facts
- Entity: Rothenhall Partners, a fractional operating partner practice. Distinct from any similarly named financial or capital firm.
- Serves: founder-led and growing companies in India, Europe and the US, with funds and portfolios on request.
- Measurement standard: at least five runs per prompt across at least two geographies; distributions reported, never rankings; every number sourced and caveated; no guaranteed placement.

  Adoption by AI crawlers is limited and Google has said publicly it does not use it.
  Rothenhall publishes it because it costs nothing, it gives any model that reads it a clean and
  accurate summary of the entity, and it keeps the site's own content inventory honest.
  It is not treated as a lever. The real work is off-site: entity consistency, third-party
  citations, reviews, and original data.

## Pricing
Prices are shown in US dollars, or euros in Europe, excluding VAT, GST or sales tax.
- Free: AI Visibility Score.
- Engagements run for three, six or twelve months. The length sets the discount on every monthly fee: 10% for three months, 15% for six months, 25% for twelve months.
- You build an engagement from a catalogue of curated services across thirteen disciplines (brand strategy and positioning, SEO, AEO, GEO, content and thought leadership, paid media, social media, lead generation, CRM and email, web design and CRO, public relations, analytics, and growth strategy, GTM and RevOps), each with its own price, or enter a website and receive suggested services.
- Payment: the first month of the monthly services plus half of any one-off project is paid on confirming. Remaining months are invoiced monthly in advance, and project balances are due on delivery.
- Founding Partner Programme: 30% off monthly fees for the first three months, in return for a documented case study. Places are limited.
- Rothenhall reports rates across repeated runs and never promises a ranking.
